versos.hebraico: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֤ה עַֽל־יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ עַל־כָּל־עַ֣ם יְהוּדָ֔ה בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִעִ֔ית לִיהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֗יא הַשָּׁנָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ית לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃

controles.web: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (the same was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
controles.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
controles.livre: Palavra que veio a Jeremias quanto a todo o povo de Judá, no quarto ano de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, (o qual é o primeiro ano de Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia);

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ עַל־כָּל־עַ֣ם יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶ֛ל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:
controles.kjv: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
controles.livre: A qual o profeta Jeremias falou a todo o povo de Judá, e a todos os moradores de Jerusalém, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: מִן־שְׁלֹ֣שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֡ה לְיֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־אָמוֹן֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְעַ֣ד׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה זֶ֚ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וָאֲדַבֵּ֧ר אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אַשְׁכֵּ֥ים וְדַבֵּ֖ר וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃

controles.web: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.
controles.kjv: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the Lord hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
controles.livre: Desde o ano treze de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, até este dia, isto é, há vinte e três anos, tem vindo a mim a palavra do SENHOR; e eu tenho vos falado, insistentemente vos falando; porém vós não escutastes.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁלַח֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֜ם אֶֽת־כָּל־עֲבָדָ֧יו הַנְּבִאִ֛ים הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹ֖חַ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וְלֹֽא־הִטִּיתֶ֥ם אֶֽת־אָזְנְכֶ֖ם לִשְׁמֹֽעַ׃

controles.web: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened, nor inclined your ear to hear)
controles.kjv: And the Lord hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR enviou a vós todos seus servos os profetas, insistentemente os enviando; porém vos não escutastes, nem inclinastes vossos ouvidos para escutar,

versos.hebraico: לֵאמֹ֗ר שֽׁוּבוּ־נָ֞א אִ֣ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֤וֹ הָֽרָעָה֙ וּמֵרֹ֣עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם וּשְׁבוּ֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמִן־עוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: saying, Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more;
controles.kjv: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the Lord hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
controles.livre: Quando diziam: Convertei-vos agora, cada um de seu mau caminho, e da maldade de vossas ações, e habitai na terra que o SENHOR deu a vós e a vossos pais para todo o sempre;

versos.hebraico: וְאַל־תֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְעָבְדָ֖ם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תַכְעִ֤יסוּ אוֹתִי֙ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א אָרַ֖ע לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: and don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; and I will do you no harm.
controles.kjv: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
controles.livre: E não segui deuses estrangeiros, para os servirdes e encurvardes  a eles, nem me provoqueis à ira com a obra de vossas mãos; para que eu não vos faça mal.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה לְמַ֧עַן הכעסוני בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיכֶ֖ם לְרַ֥ע לָכֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: Yet you have not listened to me, says Yahweh; that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.
controles.kjv: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the Lord; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
controles.livre: Porém vós não me destes ouvidos, diz o SENHOR, para me provocardes à ira com a obra de vossas mãos, para o vosso mal.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־דְּבָרָֽי׃

controles.web: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies: Because you have not heard my words,
controles.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
controles.livre: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Visto quanto não tendes ouvido minhas palavras,

versos.hebraico: הִנְנִ֣י שֹׁלֵ֡חַ וְלָקַחְתִּי֩ אֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפְּח֨וֹת צָפ֜וֹן נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶל־נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֮ עַבְדִּי֒ וַהֲבִ֨אֹתִ֜ים עַל־הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־יֹ֣שְׁבֶ֔יהָ וְעַ֛ל כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה סָבִ֑יב וְהַ֣חֲרַמְתִּ֔ים וְשַׂמְתִּים֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֔ה וּלְחָרְב֖וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says Yahweh, and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around; and I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.
controles.kjv: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
controles.livre: Eis que eu enviarei, e tomarei a todas as famílias do norte, diz o SENHOR, e a Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia, meu servo, e os trarei contra esta terra, e contra seus moradores, e contra todas estas nações ao redor; e os destruirei, e os farei de espanto, assovio, e de desolações perpétuas.

versos.hebraico: וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֣י מֵהֶ֗ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה ק֥וֹל רֵחַ֖יִם וְא֥וֹר נֵֽר׃

controles.web: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
controles.kjv: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
controles.livre: E eliminarei dentre eles a voz de júbilo e voz de alegria, voz de noivo e voz de noiva, o ruído das pedras de moer, e a luz de lâmpada.

versos.hebraico: וְהָֽיְתָה֙ כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את לְחָרְבָּ֖ה לְשַׁמָּ֑ה וְעָ֨בְד֜וּ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛לֶּה אֶת־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: This whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
controles.kjv: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
controles.livre: E toda esta terra se tornará em desolação, e em espanto; e estas nações servirão ao rei da Babilônia por setenta anos.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה כִמְלֹ֣אות שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֡ה אֶפְקֹ֣ד עַל־מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֩ וְעַל־הַגּ֨וֹי הַה֧וּא נְאֻם־יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־עֲוֺנָ֖ם וְעַל־אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ לְשִֽׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: It shall happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, says Yahweh, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it desolate forever.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the Lord, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
controles.livre: E será que, quando os setenta anos forem completados, punirei ao rei da Babilônia e àquela nação por sua maldade, diz o SENHOR, assim como a terra dos Caldeus; e a tornarei em desolações para sempre.

versos.hebraico: והבאיתי עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔יא אֶת־כָּל־דְּבָרַ֖י אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֣רְתִּי עָלֶ֑יהָ אֵ֤ת כָּל־הַכָּתוּב֙ בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נִבָּ֥א יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ עַל־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
controles.kjv: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
controles.livre: E trarei sobre aquela terra todas as minhas palavras que falado contra ela: tudo o que está escrito neste livro, que Jeremias profetizou contra todas as nações.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י עָֽבְדוּ־בָ֤ם גַּם־הֵ֨מָּה֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּמְלָכִ֖ים גְּדוֹלִ֑ים וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֥י לָהֶ֛ם כְּפָעֳלָ֖ם וּכְמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: For many nations and great kings shall make bondservants of them, even of them; and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.
controles.kjv: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
controles.livre: Porque também deles se servirão muitas nações e grandes reis; assim lhes pagarei conforme seus feitos, conforme a obra de suas mãos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵלַ֔י קַ֠ח אֶת־כּ֨וֹס הַיַּ֧יִן הַחֵמָ֛ה הַזֹּ֖את מִיָּדִ֑י וְהִשְׁקִיתָ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י שֹׁלֵ֥חַ אוֹתְךָ֖ אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to me: take this cup of the wine of wrath at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.
controles.kjv: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
controles.livre: Porque assim me disse o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Toma de minha mão este copo de vinho do meu furor, e dá de beber dele a todas as nações às quais eu te envio.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁת֕וּ וְהִֽתְגֹּֽעֲשׁ֖וּ וְהִתְהֹלָ֑לוּ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַחֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵ֖חַ בֵּינֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: They shall drink, and reel back and forth, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
controles.kjv: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
controles.livre: E beberão, tremerão, e enlouquecerão, por causa da espada que eu envio entre eles.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶקַּ֥ח אֶת־הַכּ֖וֹס מִיַּ֣ד יְהוָ֑ה וָֽאַשְׁקֶה֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־שְׁלָחַ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Then took I the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:
controles.kjv: Then took I the cup at the Lord’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the Lord had sent me:
controles.livre: E eu tomei o copo da mão do SENHOR, e dei de beber a todas as nações às quais o SENHOR tinha me enviado:

versos.hebraico: אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וְאֶת־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶת־מְלָכֶ֖יהָ אֶת־שָׂרֶ֑יהָ לָתֵ֨ת אֹתָ֜ם לְחָרְבָּ֧ה לְשַׁמָּ֛ה לִשְׁרֵקָ֥ה וְלִקְלָלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and its kings, and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is this day;
controles.kjv: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
controles.livre: A Jerusalém, às cidades de Judá; e a seus reis e seus príncipes, para torná-los em desolação, em espanto, em assovio, e em maldição, tal como é hoje;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֛יִם וְאֶת־עֲבָדָ֥יו וְאֶת־שָׂרָ֖יו וְאֶת־כָּל־עַמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
controles.kjv: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
controles.livre: A Faraó rei do Egito, e a seus servos, seus príncipes, e a todo o seu povo;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ כָּל־הָעֶ֔רֶב וְאֵ֕ת כָּל־מַלְכֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הָע֑וּץ וְאֵ֗ת כָּל־מַלְכֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְאֶת־אַשְׁקְל֤וֹן וְאֶת־עַזָּה֙ וְאֶת־עֶקְר֔וֹן וְאֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית אַשְׁדּֽוֹד׃

controles.web: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of the Uz, and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
controles.kjv: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
controles.livre: E a todas os povos ali misturados; e a todos os reis da terra de Uz, e a todos os reis da terra dos filisteus, e a Asquelom, Gaza, e Ecrom; e aos restantes de Asdode;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־אֱד֥וֹם וְאֶת־מוֹאָ֖ב וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon;
controles.kjv: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
controles.livre: A Edom, Moabe, e aos filhos de Amom;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ כָּל־מַלְכֵי־צֹ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־מַלְכֵ֣י צִיד֑וֹן וְאֵת֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיָּֽם׃

controles.web: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;
controles.kjv: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
controles.livre: E a todos os reis de Tiro, e a todos os reis da Sidom, e aos reis das terras litorâneas que estão além do mar;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־דְּדָ֤ן וְאֶת־תֵּימָא֙ וְאֶת־בּ֔וּז וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־קְצוּצֵ֥י פֵאָֽה׃

controles.web: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;
controles.kjv: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
controles.livre: E a Dedã, e Tema, e Buz, e a todos os dos cantos mais distantes.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־מַלְכֵ֣י עֲרָ֑ב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־מַלְכֵ֣י הָעֶ֔רֶב הַשֹּׁכְנִ֖ים בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;
controles.kjv: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
controles.livre: E a todos os reis de Arábia, e a todos os reis dos povos misturados que habitam no deserto;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־מַלְכֵ֣י זִמְרִ֗י וְאֵת֙ כָּל־מַלְכֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־מַלְכֵ֥י מָדָֽי׃

controles.web: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
controles.kjv: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
controles.livre: E a todos os reis de Zinri, e a todos os reis de Elão, e a todos os reis de Média;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־מַלְכֵ֣י הַצָּפ֗וֹן הַקְּרֹבִ֤ים וְהָֽרְחֹקִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֔יו וְאֵת֙ כָּל־הַמַּמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ שֵׁשַׁ֖ךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֥ה אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
controles.kjv: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
controles.livre: E a todos os reis do norte, os de perto e os de longe, tanto uns como os outros; e a todos os reinos da terra que estão sobre a face da terra; e o rei de Sesaque beberá depois deles.

versos.hebraico: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֡םס כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁת֤וּ וְשִׁכְרוּ֙ וּקְי֔וּ וְנִפְל֖וּ וְלֹ֣א תָק֑וּמוּ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַחֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵ֖חַ בֵּינֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
controles.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
controles.livre: Pois tu lhes dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Bebei, e embriagai-vos, vomitai, caí, e não vos levanteis, por causa da espada que eu envio entre vós.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֧י יְמָאֲנ֛וּ לָקַֽחַת־הַכּ֥וֹס מִיָּדְךָ֖ לִשְׁתּ֑וֹת וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שָׁת֥וֹ תִשְׁתּֽוּ׃

controles.web: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: You shall surely drink.
controles.kjv: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
controles.livre: E será que, se não querem tomar o copo de tua mão para beber, então tu lhes dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Certamente bebereis;

versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ הִנֵּ֨ה בָעִ֜יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא־שְׁמִ֣י עָלֶ֗יהָ אָֽנֹכִי֙ מֵחֵ֣ל לְהָרַ֔ע וְאַתֶּ֖ם הִנָּקֵ֣ה תִנָּק֑וּ לֹ֣א תִנָּק֔וּ כִּ֣י חֶ֗רֶב אֲנִ֤י קֹרֵא֙ עַל־כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh of Armies.
controles.kjv: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the Lord of hosts.
controles.livre: Pois eis que na cidade que se chama pelo meu nome eu começo a castigar; e vós ficaríeis impunes? Não ficareis impunes, porque eu estou chamando espada contra todos os moradores da terra, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּה֙ תִּנָּבֵ֣א אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם יְהוָ֞ה מִמָּר֤וֹם יִשְׁאָג֙ וּמִמְּע֤וֹן קָדְשׁוֹ֙ יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔וֹ שָׁאֹ֤ג יִשְׁאַג֙ עַל־נָוֵ֔הוּ הֵידָד֙ כְּדֹרְכִ֣ים יַֽעֲנֶ֔ה אֶ֥ל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Therefore prophesy you against them all these words, and tell them, Yahweh will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he will mightily roar against his fold; he will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
controles.kjv: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The Lord shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
controles.livre: Tu, pois, profetizarás a eles todas estas palavras, e lhes dirás: O SENHOR bramará desde o alto, e levantará sua voz a sua santa morada; bramará intensamente sobre sua morada; dará forte grito, tal como os que pisam as uvas, contra todos os moradores da terra.

versos.hebraico: בָּ֤א שָׁאוֹן֙ עַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽיהוָה֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם נִשְׁפָּ֥ט ה֖וּא לְכָל־בָּשָׂ֑ר הָרְשָׁעִ֛ים נְתָנָ֥ם לַחֶ֖רֶב נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: A noise shall come even to the end of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with the nations; he will enter into judgment with all flesh: as for the wicked, he will give them to the sword, says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the Lord hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: Chegará o estrondo até o extremo da terra; porque o SENHOR disputa com as nações; entrará em juízo com todos;  e entregará os perversos à espada, diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנֵּ֥ה רָעָ֛ה יֹצֵ֖את מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֑וֹי וְסַ֣עַר גָּד֔וֹל יֵע֖וֹר מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, Behold, evil shall go out from nation to nation, and a great storm shall be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
controles.livre: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eis que a calamidade  sai de nação em nação, e uma grande tempestade se levantará desde os confins da terra.

versos.hebraico: וְהָי֞וּ חַֽלְלֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹ֣א יִסָּפְד֗וּ וְלֹ֤א יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְדֹ֛מֶן עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃

controles.web: The slain of Yahweh shall be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung on the surface of the ground.
controles.kjv: And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
controles.livre: E os mortos pelo SENHOR naquele dia serão desde um extremo da terra até o outro extremo; não serão lamentados, nem recolhidos, nem sepultados; serão como esterco sobre a face da terra.

versos.hebraico: הֵילִ֨ילוּ הָרֹעִ֜ים וְזַעֲק֗וּ וְהִֽתְפַּלְּשׁוּ֙ אַדִּירֵ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן כִּֽי־מָלְא֥וּ יְמֵיכֶ֖ם לִטְב֑וֹחַ וּתְפוֹצ֣וֹתִיכֶ֔ם וּנְפַלְתֶּ֖ם כִּכְלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה׃

controles.web: Wail, you shepherds, and cry; and wallow in dust, you principal of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are fully come, and you shall fall like a goodly vessel.
controles.kjv: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
controles.livre: Uivai, pastores, e clamai; e revolvei-vos na cinza , líderes do rebanho; porque já se cumpriram vossos dias para serdes mortos; e sereis dispersos e caireis como um vaso precioso.

versos.hebraico: וְאָבַ֥ד מָנ֖וֹס מִן־הָֽרֹעִ֑ים וּפְלֵיטָ֖ה מֵאַדִּירֵ֥י הַצֹּֽאן׃

controles.web: The shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
controles.kjv: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
controles.livre: E não haverá meio de fuga para os pastores, nem escape para os líderes do rebanho.

versos.hebraico: ק֚וֹל צַעֲקַ֣ת הָֽרֹעִ֔ים וִֽילְלַ֖ת אַדִּירֵ֣י הַצֹּ֑אן כִּֽי־שֹׁדֵ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מַרְעִיתָֽם׃

controles.web: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the principal of the flock! for Yahweh lays waste their pasture.
controles.kjv: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the Lord hath spoiled their pasture.
controles.livre: Haverá voz do grito dos pastores, e uivo dos lideres do rebanho; porque o SENHOR assolou os seus pastos.

versos.hebraico: וְנָדַ֖מּוּ נְא֣וֹת הַשָּׁל֑וֹם מִפְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַף־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The peaceable folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the Lord.
controles.livre: E as pastagens quietas serão devastadas por causa do furor da ira do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: עָזַ֥ב כַּכְּפִ֖יר סֻכּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־הָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצָם֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה מִפְּנֵי֙ חֲר֣וֹן הַיּוֹנָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.
controles.kjv: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
controles.livre: Ele deixou seu abrigo tal como filhote de leão; pois assolada foi a terra deles, pelo furor do opressor, e pelo furor de sua ira.
